title: Help for SMEs Adversely Affected by Increased Fuel and Energy Costs Due to Conflict in Ukraine
what_it_is: Help for SMEs Adversely Affected by Increased Fuel and Energy Costs Due to Conflict in Ukraine

sections.label: Energy prices and business support
sections.summary: Singapore is affected by high global gas prices, so EMA safeguards energy security and the Government supports businesses with grants and loans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, as Singapore is heavily reliant on the global market for our energy supplies, we will be affected by the high and volatile global gas prices resulting from the conflict.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Electricity prices are likely to remain elevated, or increase even further, in tandem with the escalating global energy costs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: EMA has taken measures to safeguard our energy security and moderate the impact of the conflict.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: I have shared them before These include: one, ensuring that electricity generation companies (gencos) have sufficient fuel reserves; two, establishing a Standby Fuel Facility (SFF) which gencos can tap on to produce electricity; and three, introducing the Temporary Retail Electricity Contracting Support (TRECS) scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We have extended TRECS from March to May 2022 and will extend it further if necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are also working with gencos and electricity retailers to offer longer-term, fixed price contracts to consumers who wish to have more price stability.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Government has a suite of measures to support businesses, especially SMEs, to cope with higher costs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Small Business Recovery Grant (SBRG) will help eligible firms in sectors most badly affected by COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Businesses which need financing support can also tap on ESG's programmes, such as the Temporary Bridging Loan, the Enterprise Financing Scheme, the SME Working Capital Loan, to ease their cashflows.
